Адрес сервиса до /v1, как в документации: Service URL up to /v1, as in the OpenAI docs. The app adds the rest of the request path itself. Any service with an OpenAI-compatible API will do.
Включено: звук может уйти и к провайдера: On: audio may also go to providers that keep it.
Pick from the list or type it in. The default is Claude Sonnet 5.5: it picks out decisions and tasks accurately; a 40-minute meeting costs about $0.15-0.2.
Pick from the list or type it in. The default is ElevenLabs Scribe v2: it understands Russian well and tells speakers apart.
Где открывается расшифровка по кнопке «Р: Where the transcript opens from the Transcript button and from the "ready" message.
Готовые настройки сервиса, который превр: Ready-made settings for the speech-to-text service: they fill in the URL and model. The recording is sent there only with your consent.
Готовые настройки языковой модели, котор: Ready-made settings for the language model that drafts the minutes: they fill in the URL and model. The transcript is sent there only when you ask for the minutes.
За какими программами следить. Убрать пр: Which apps to watch. You can also remove an app right from the prompt.
What to call you in the minutes instead of "Я" (me).
Какой микрофон записывать. «Как в Window: Which microphone to record. "Windows default" is the default microphone in Windows: if you change it mid-meeting, recording switches to the new one. Pick a specific one if the meeting app uses another microphone. Takes effect from the next recording.
Ключ доступа к сервису. Хранится в диспе: Access key for the service. Stored in Windows Credential Manager, not in a file. The key is tied to the URL: speech recognition and minutes on the same server share it.
Окно встречи - только то место экрана, г: Meeting window - only the part of the screen where the meeting program window is: the rest of the screen and notifications are not recorded, a window placed on top of it is. Screen with the meeting window - the whole monitor it is on.
Открывает и прячет блокнот встречи повер: Shows and hides the meeting notepad on top of other windows: agenda and your notes, each line gets the recording minute. Participants can't see it; the model builds the minutes around your notes.
Откуда брать голоса собеседников: то, чт: Where to take the other participants' voices from: whatever plays in these headphones or speakers. "Windows default" is the default output device. Pick a specific one if the meeting app plays sound elsewhere, for example to headphones while the Windows default is speakers or a monitor. Takes effect from the next recording.
Программа будет запускаться вместе с Win: The app starts with Windows and waits in the notification area.
Работает из любой программы. Щелкните в: Works from any app. Click the field and press the shortcut.
Раз в день программа спрашивает GitHub,: Once a day the program asks GitHub whether a new version is out and offers to update. The update installs itself and the program restarts. To check now, use "Check for updates" at the icon by the clock.
Слова, которые распознавание пишет непра: Words that speech recognition gets wrong: terms, names, surnames. The transcript is fixed automatically.
Ставит отметку важного места во время за: Marks an important moment while recording so you can find it quickly later.
Строка записи и сообщения программы не п: The recording bar and app messages stay out of screen sharing: participants won't see them.
Сюда пишутся встречи, на каждую своя пап: Meetings are recorded here, each in its own folder. Video and audio files put here also show up in the list.
Текст остается, удаляются звук (около 30: The text stays; the audio (about 30 MB per hour) and the video are deleted. Transcribing again is not possible after that.
Что делать, когда запись остановлена: сп: What to do when recording stops: ask, send right away or just save.
Что и как модель пишет в протоколе. Исхо: What the model writes in the minutes and how. The default is the approved format: decisions, tasks, open questions, a section for the analyst.
Экономное - 720p, до 250 МБ за час; обыч: Economy - 720p, up to 250 MB per hour; normal - 1080p, up to 450 MB; high - as on the screen, up to 1 GB.
Язык окон программы. Меняется после пере: Language of the app windows. Changes after a restart: the button appears under the choice.
The meeting video is recorded together with the audio. The recording bar, the notebook and the app's messages are not recorded while "Hide the bar when sharing screen" is on. The video shows in the meeting above the transcript.
Некоторые провайдеры сохраняют присланны: Some providers keep the audio they receive. The ban works through OpenRouter; a service connected directly has its own rules.
Claude Desktop и другие помощники ИИ с п: Claude Desktop and other AI assistants with MCP support will see your meetings, minutes, open tasks and costs, and can write or fix minutes when asked. Copy the config and paste it into the assistant's settings: for Claude Desktop it's the claude_desktop_config.json file. If it already has mcpServers, move only the qg-knotes entry there.
Выключено: через OpenRouter звук не уход: Off: through OpenRouter the audio doesn't go to providers that keep it after transcription.
Программа встречи включила микрофон или: When a meeting app turns on the microphone or a calendar meeting starts, a question at the top asks whether to start recording.
